assets.name: Ashlar Wall
assets.description: 4 m bays with independently bonded faces over a mortar core. Origin at the base center.

evidence.art: Returned end headers, varied ashlar and continuous coping read as bonded cut stone in the end view and courtyard.
evidence.godot: Isolated GLB and assembled showcase imported in Godot 4.6.3.

assets.qualification_scope: Cut-stone terrace kit; straight bays and engineered foundation contact

assets.name: Vaulted Gateway
assets.description: 2.68 m clear opening. Full-depth voussoirs with cut-to-curve spandrel courses. Origin at threshold center.

evidence.art: Recessed spandrels, a faced vault and low quoin tails make a structurally legible gate. Opening stays clear.
evidence.godot: Isolated GLB and assembled showcase imported in Godot 4.6.3.

assets.qualification_scope: Cut-stone terrace kit; straight bays and engineered foundation contact

assets.name: Limestone Stair
assets.description: 3.6 m-wide route. Nine 0.18 m risers and 0.34 m treads. Origin at first riser.

evidence.art: The stone nosings sit on a continuous bearing; the upper cap meets the landing. Nine tread heights verified.
evidence.godot: Isolated GLB and assembled showcase imported in Godot 4.6.3.

assets.qualification_scope: Cut-stone terrace kit; straight bays and engineered foundation contact

assets.name: Faulted Limestone Escarpment
assets.description: Continuous sedimentary bench with dipping strata, eroded joints and a foundation shelf. Local Z=0 at the foot.

evidence.art: Dipping strata and weathered surfaces read continuously under both platforms. Mesh is manifold and walking surfaces remain clear.
evidence.godot: Isolated GLB and assembled showcase imported in Godot 4.6.3.

assets.qualification_scope: Cut-stone terrace kit; straight bays and engineered foundation contact

assets.name: Honed Limestone
assets.description: Image-backed pale cut-stone finish. 1.35 m UV repeat for architectural modules.

evidence.art: Mineral tones and roughness hold under neutral, grazing and tactical light with a 1.35 m repeat.
evidence.godot: Verified on the assembled showcase GLB in Godot 4.6.3.

assets.qualification_scope: Cut-stone terrace kit; straight bays and engineered foundation contact

assets.name: Irregular Stone Court
assets.description: Continuous paved formation with staggered sett courses. Origin at center of walking plane.

evidence.art: Staggered flagstones turn into the edge courses over continuous support. The standing plane meets the stairs.
evidence.godot: Verified on the assembled showcase GLB in Godot 4.6.3.

assets.qualification_scope: Cut-stone terrace kit; straight bays and engineered foundation contact
